_comment: Mutation testing over the modules where a surviving mutant means silent divergence rather than a visible bug. Coverage proves a line ran; this proves something checked what it did. Scoped rather than repo-wide because triage is the real cost, and a mutant in a dev warning is not worth anyone's afternoon.
_comment_plugins: Named explicitly: pnpm's strict node_modules means Stryker's auto-discovery walks a tree the plugin is not hoisted into.
_comment_thresholds: break is the roadmap's target, now met, and it applies to the overall score. Every individual module is also >=90 (see MUTATION.md); Stryker cannot gate per file, so that part is a review target. Ratchet this up as survivors die — never down.
